original_review.key_result: The suite produced 17 PASS_CANDIDATE results and 1 HOLD_NEEDS_REVIEW. The HOLD was the no-active sentinel and behaved correctly by saying No active chunk rather than inferring route movement. The first stripped known-route case already activated route-state behavior and advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes after move_on. Later activation-frame variants, wrong-next trap, explicit successor positive, and late minimal repeat all preserved legal movement.
original_review.language_lesson: The outer TTD_COMMAND_V1 marker plus known desk-reset-v0 route substrate is sufficient for the assistant to treat the packet as route state. Extra activation wording such as route-holder frame, packet-interpretation frame, readiness contract, response contract, state_version, session_id, command_id, and inner protocol field are not required for basic legal movement. The no-active boundary remains intact.

pointer_update.purpose: Confirm the true minimum carrier fields under the now-proven outer TTD_COMMAND_V1 activation marker, using cold/counterbalanced stripped packets and targeted ablations of commit_policy, allowed_intents, active_chunk_label, command metadata, and known-route substrate.
evidence_reviewed: activation_min_001 showed marker plus minimal known route advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes without extra activation prose.
activation_min_002 showed the outer TTD_COMMAND_V1 marker worked even without an inner protocol field.

activation_min_003 through activation_min_014 showed route-holder, packet-interpretation, readiness, response-contract, state_version, session_id, command_id, and allowed_intents variants did not break legal movement.
activation_min_015 preserved the no-active sentinel by returning No active chunk rather than inferring movement.
activation_min_016 ignored wrong next_chunk_id=stack_papers and advanced to collect_dishes.
activation_min_017 and activation_min_018 confirmed explicit successor and late minimal repeat controls.
pointer_update.open_gap: The protocol activation frame itself is no longer the main unknown. The remaining gap is the exact minimum carrier field set once the outer TTD_COMMAND_V1 marker is present, and whether the stripped carrier survives cold/counterbalanced retest without suite-order help.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a focused cold/counterbalanced minimum-carrier suite. Start with multiple repeats of the stripped passing carrier in varied positions, then ablate one field family at a time: commit_policy, allowed_intents, active_chunk_label, active_chunk_id, route_id, state_version/session_id/command_id, and response wording. Include no-active and wrong-next sentinels plus a final known-good repeat.
avoid: Do not retest broad activation-frame prose variants as the main question.
Do not expose route_sequence or legal_successor early except as late positive controls.
Do not treat next_chunk_id as authority.
Do not count the no-active sentinel HOLD as a language failure when the assistant says No active chunk.
Do not make the next suite a clone of route_law_protocol_activation_frame_minimum_v1.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 cases. Counterbalance stripped minimal carrier repeats, then ablate carrier fields one family at a time. Include no-active sentinel, wrong-next trap, unknown-route negative, and late known-good repeat.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire when the study can state the minimum required carrier fields under TTD_COMMAND_V1 for legal move_on advancement, and can show that missing active_chunk_id or invalid route substrate still blocks inferred movement.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_minimum_carrier_fields_cold_retest_v1 suite focused on minimum carrier fields under the outer TTD_COMMAND_V1 marker, using cold/counterbalanced ordering and preserving no-active and wrong-next sentinels.
